flags: Live web presence: the operator's website (www.scenicmountainrv.com) no longer resolves; what remains is Explore Georgia, the Good Sam Park listing and RV Life ($$). Under the presence rule the Good Sam Park profile is the presence indicator and RV Life $$ the price indicator; no posted rate anywhere. The website field should probably lose the dead URL.

Price: guest reports (per a web search summary, not read first-hand) give $60 a night in an RV Life review of March 2025 and $37-50 on Campendium 2019-2024. No gateway within 40 km (Atlanta 134 km). If $60 is current it is over the $50 gate even at the Good Sam 10% ($54). Unverified - a phone call is the only operator source.
Long-stay: the note says daily/weekly/monthly; the five-test check could not be run with no operator page.
